purpose: Independent bilingual retrieval and omission measurement. Semantic support is independently labeled but lexical retrieval must never claim it was proven. No outcome-derived recall threshold.
acceptance: All bounded whole-source controls retain the decisive record and its exact qualification.
Every admitted partial source retains exact parent identity, is unverified and is not claim-eligible.
Every known omission stays explicit; no result proves capability absence or semantic support.

scoring.full_source_recall: decisive source present unchanged / labeled whole-source controls
scoring.bounded_discovery_recall: both decisive fact and qualification present / all bilingual bounded cases
scoring.silent_omission_count: gold missing while selection_complete or capability_absence_proven is true
